data.action: 坐在学生会会长办公椅上，衬衫领带微松，黑丝长腿优雅交叠展露于桌侧，红瞳平静注视眼前之人
data.camera: cowboy shot, sitting by executive desk, slightly low angle
data.description: 千年学生会办公室深处，莉音坐在人体工学真皮转椅上。深夜推演结束，她将黑色高领与白衬衫领口稍稍解开散热，修长挺拔的坐姿不减威严。办公桌旁，包裹在细腻黑丝中的笔直双腿交叠侧放，红宝石眼瞳倒映着悬浮光屏与桌面台灯的微光。
data.promptProse: Tsukatsuki Rio sits back in an ergonomic chair beside her sleek executive desk in the late-night Seminar office, her shirt collar unbuttoned with a loosened necktie revealing her collarbone while her sheer black-stockinged legs rest crossed at the side of the desk. A warm desk lamp and faint holographic displays cast soft shadows around her calm crimson gaze.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 研讨会办公室制服半解
data.animaCaption: She sits by the executive desk with loosened collar and crossed pantyhose legs.
